The structure of Li4Mn8O12 (LiMn2O3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for Li and Mn centers (four O neighbors each, distances 1.896–2.081 Å) and octahedral coordination for O centers (four Li and two Mn neighbors, 1.896–2.233 Å). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Li tetrahedra and Mn octahedra, and edge-sharing between Li tetrahedra and Mn octahedra, though these selected patterns do not assert an exclusive sharing type.
